description: Today's local news of one city: for each item a title, a short summary, the source and a link to the full article. Text comes in the newsroom's own language — Russian, Thai, Arabic or Chinese — and covers what a city portal publishes about itself, not national wires.

city.description: city slug from list_cities, e.g. pattaya or moscow

edition.description: edition key from list_editions: ru | th | ae | sa | tw

limit.description: how many news items to return, up to 20 (default 10)

name: city_news
